title: Voruna
extract:
Release Date: November 30th, 2022
Beware the telltale bloodcurdling howl when the primeval hunt begins anew. Nightfall engulfs the hallowed moonlit shrine, where sacred beasts of claw and fang prowl. Heed the wolven queen, Voruna, here she decrees her midnight feast. Reveling in feral carnage, her loyal lupine fiends, the silent Dynar, chaotic Raksh, ravenous Lycath, and ferocious Ulfrun ravage their prey once unleashed. Beneath lunar glow upon scarlet soil, tremble before her monstrous grin. Voruna and her wolves' hunt resumed in Update 32.2 (2022-11-30): Lua's Prey.
 Voruna is a Warframe that leads a wolf pack, which provides her with damage and stealth. Her Passive invokes protection from her pack, bestowing her either increased Parkour Velocity, immunity to Status Effects, Heavy Attack Efficiency, or death prevention.  Shroud of Dynar renders her Invisible with increased Movement Speed until she attacks, bestowing her increased melee Critical Damage and Status Chance.  Fangs of Raksh pounces an enemy to inflict 5 random status effects stacked up to 10 times each, spreading upon their death.  Lycath's Hunt has enemies slain by melee to guarantee a Health Orb or slain by headshots to guarantee an Energy Orb.  Ulfrun's Descent enters a ferocious stance with 5 charges to lunge at an enemy, with successful kills strengthening the ability's damage, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

Acquisition
Voruna's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation C of Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Alternatively they can be purchased from Archimedean Yonta on the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero (requires completion of Angels of the Zariman to access) with  Lua Thrax Plasm, awarded from Conjunction Survival in quantities of 3 (Yuvarium), 5 (Circulus or Yuvarium Steel Path), or 6 (Circulus Steel Path) per rotation or dropped by Hollow Thrax Centurion and Hollow Thrax Legatus that appears at the end of every Conjunction Survival rotation at a 30% drop rate; each component costs 75, while the main blueprint requires 125, totaling to 350 Lua Thrax Plasm.

Crafting

Despite being obtainable after The War Within, Voruna's crafting requires  Voidgel Orb which are only found on the Zariman Ten Zero, accessible after completing Angels of the Zariman.

Lore & History

Notes
If Voruna wields her Signature Weapons:
 Perigale/ Perigale Prime: Gains 24 more Ammo Maximum, for a total of 48/56.
 Sarofang/ Sarofang Prime: Heavy Attack Slam vortex requirement reduced to 5x Combo Multiplier.
Dynar and Raksh are both labeled Voruna Armor in Voruna's Appearance Shoulder Pad Attachments which can be swapped out for other armors. This is purely cosmetic and removing them does not affect Voruna's usage on her abilities.

Trivia
Voruna is the 51st unique Warframe to be released.
Voruna's "wolf pack" consists of four different spectral wolf skulls attached to her shoulders and hips.
Dynar is attached to her left shoulder and wears a small metal patch over its front eyes.
Raksh is attached to her right shoulder and has mouth straps on its jawline.
Lycath is attached to her left hip, possessing horns and a nose ring.
Ulfrun is attached to her right hip, bearing a pair of long sharp fangs.
Her concept artwork, created in partnership with renowned comic book artist Joe "Joe Mad" Madureira, were first revealed in TennoCon 2022's Art of Warframe panel.
Her colorized concept art was shown in Devstream 164, then her voted name reveal and the work-in-progress model sculpts followed in Devstream 165, and finally her gameplay demonstration in Devstream 166.
Chronologically, she was showcased before the 50th Warframe  Styanax, whose animated teaser debut came after in Tennolive 2022.
As a community incentive for donation to the Quest to Conquer Cancer 2022 campaign, the "Vote for the name for our Wolf-inspired Warframe" reward unlocked on October 21, 2022, in the official Warframe forums poll thread upon reaching $70,000 CAD. The reward tier was originally set at $80,000 CAD, then later shuffled forward to meet the internal development cutoff schedule.
Digital Extremes compiled a list of eligible names for the QTCC public poll reward, from the initial Design Council exclusive suggestion forum thread, which opened after Devstream 164 until October 14, 2022.
Once the QTCC poll closed, the top 5 names were used with Voruna coming out at first place, Raksha in second, Lycath in third, Ulfra in fourth, and Dynara in fifth. The runner-up names were given to Voruna's four wolf-heads; aside from Lycath, DE decided to alter the other three wolves' names to be more gender-neutral.
Voruna's name was suggested by Design Council member Orabell.
The name Voruna is a variation of Žvorūna, a name synonymous to Medeina, the Lithuanian goddess of forests, trees, and animals. In Lithuanian mythology, she is described as a lone voluptuous and beautiful huntress often escorted by a pack of wolves, with her form exuding both divine and demonic traits.
Voruna later gained a deluxe skin called the Medeina Skin based on this namesake.
With the addition of Warframe Passives since Update 18.13 (2016-05-27), Voruna is the first newly-developed Warframe to not possess a dedicated passive ability of her own. Instead, each of her four abilities enables in-mission selection of a passive effect by holding down the ability button.
She was originally planned to release with The Duviri Paradox, which was delayed until 2023 for further development. In Devstream 165, she was announced to release with Lua's Prey instead.
